Source:

Description

INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL_1: full 32-bit IMAGE_SIZE (image size to load, in 4-byte/DWORD units). The live owner is usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv, which captures IMAGE_SIZE from the host FIFO command write and continuously drives this regblock copy (hw=w); the regblock is the single read-back source (sw=r). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL command summary.

Field Descriptions

IMAGE_SIZE - Image Size

Image size to load, in 4-byte (DWORD) units. Full 32-bit IMAGE_SIZE. Firmware accesses route through cpuif, while usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv remains the live owner and mirrors the committed state back through hw=w.
